richiami.difetto: Due to a non-conformity in production a specific number of safety harness lap strap anchor plates may potentially not meet the strength requirements under impact loading set for this product. This could result in an inability of the harness in use to provide the optimum level of protection required during an accident.
richiami.modello: KRUSS COMPETITION HARNESS , KRUSS COMPETITION HARNESS
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected harnesses and replace with quality assured items.
richiami.titolo: SAFETY HARNESS LAP STRAP ANCHOR PLATE COULD FAIL UNDER IMPACT LOADING
